risk_categories.risk: Native GROBID source build requires JDK 21 while local Java is 17; Docker CRF image worked, but full/DL image accuracy remains a future comparison question.
risk_categories.validation_gate: Record container/image version, service health, model/profile, API responses, TEI parse success, and bibliography/citation quality against golden papers.

risk_categories.risk: Hybrid docling-fast backend has lifecycle/model-cache cost; if cache is absent, model downloads or network dependency may reappear.
risk_categories.validation_gate: Future probe must preflight backend health, cache inventory, network-disabled mode, per-paper runtime, and fallback/blocker diagnostics.
blocks_adoption_until: typed blocker taxonomy covers backend/model failures

risk_categories.risk: S03 did not include scanned/image-only PDFs or independent table ground truth, so OCR/table fidelity remains unproven.
risk_categories.validation_gate: Use golden papers with known table structures, scanned/layout-heavy controls, page coordinates, reading order checks, and reviewer adjudication.
blocks_adoption_until: OCR quality threshold met or typed blocker emitted

risk_categories.risk: Bounding boxes and TEI refs are candidate anchors; deterministic EvidencePath conventions and stale-hash protections are not yet specified for combined sidecars.
risk_categories.validation_gate: Define stable element IDs, JSON-pointer/path conventions, PDF hash binding, page-coordinate normalization, and invalid/stale span refusal checks.
blocks_adoption_until: stale source hash refusal is verified

risk_categories.risk: Adaptix can map shape/types but cannot validate semantic correctness, table fidelity, reading order, or graph-readiness.
risk_categories.validation_gate: Adapter tests must be paired with semantic quality reviewers and daily-archive validation gates.
blocks_adoption_until: semantic reviewer packet completion is required

risk_categories.risk: quant-mind patterns are useful, but runtime adoption would pull OpenAI/API/network and placeholder GraphKnowledge/storage/retrieval/RAG assumptions.
risk_categories.validation_gate: Only reimplement selected patterns under daily-archive schemas; prohibit quant-mind runtime imports in implementation milestone.
blocks_adoption_until: no quant-mind runtime dependency is introduced

risk_categories.risk: Parser success could be mistaken for import eligibility unless graph-readiness review remains independent.
risk_categories.validation_gate: Run review artifact post-check before manifest synthesis and require completed review with output_contract_completed=true before any future eligibility promotion.
blocks_adoption_until: no-write import rehearsal remains false until explicitly authorized

validation_gates: EvidencePath source-span and coordinate anchoring tests
review packet completion and graph-readiness review post-check
no-write import rehearsal with all graph/import flags false
